defense_memos.defense_topic: IRC Section 41 R&D Credit Four-Part Test Substantiation
defense_memos.audit_trigger: IRS examination of $16,590.00 Section 41 research credit on Form 6765.
defense_memos.defense_position: Qualified research activities satisfy all 4 statutory prongs under Treas. Reg. § 1.41-4: Permissible Purpose (AST compiler optimization), Elimination of Uncertainty (memory throughput benchmarking), Process of Experimentation (iterative test runs), and Technological Nature (computer science). Contemporaneous commit logs, git diffs, and engineering timesheets substantiate 100% of claimed QREs.
evidence_artifacts: Developer Timesheets & Project JIRA/Git Commit Logs
Technical Architecture Specifications & Benchmark Test Runs
